# PAP - PHP App Publication

> PAP is a CLI toolchain to build, lint, deploy and test PHP applications,
> configured solely with YAML files (mandatory `pap.yml`, optional `pap.local.yml`).
> It has a fixed command set and no custom task names. PAP runs anywhere
> inside a Git repository and resolves all configured paths from the repository root.

Install with `composer require pixelbrackets/pap`. Write `pap.yml` directly
using the reference below, or run `./vendor/bin/pap init` for an interactive
wizard. New projects may start from the skeleton instead.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap/blob/master/README.md): Overview, requirements, installation and usage
- [Configuration](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap/blob/master/docs/configuration.md): Full annotated reference of all `pap.yml` options
- [Walkthrough](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap/blob/master/docs/walkthrough.md): Step-by-step setup of a project from scratch

## Commands

Every command that takes a stage accepts it as argument or `--stage`. Without
one, `settings.default-stage` is used, falling back to `local`.

- `pap init` - interactive wizard to generate `pap.yml`
- `pap publish [stage]` - full stack: lint, test:unit, deploy, test:smoke, test:integration
- `pap deploy [stage]` - build, sync files, run `composer install` on the stage, write `.pap.lock`; refused if the branch is not in `lock-branches`
- `pap build [stage]` - run `buildassets` and `buildapp`
- `pap buildassets` - mirror, concat and minify CSS/JS/images
- `pap buildapp [stage]` - run `composer install` locally
- `pap sync [stage]` - rsync files only, no build
- `pap watch [stage]` - watch for changes and auto-sync
- `pap lint` / `pap lint:fix` - check or fix files (built-in: `php -l` on `lint-paths`)
- `pap test:unit` - run PHPUnit against the local code
- `pap test:smoke [stage]` (alias `smoketest`) - HTTP request against the stage `origin`
- `pap test [stage]` / `pap test:integration [stage]` - run Codeception tests against the deployed stage
- `pap composer:command [stage] [cmd]` - run a Composer command on the stage
- `pap ssh [stage]` / `pap ssh:exec [stage] [cmd]` - open SSH session or run a command on the stage
- `pap view [stage]` - open the stage `origin` in the browser
- `pap show [section]` - show the merged configuration
- `pap list` - list all available commands

## Config

Files are merged in this order, later overrides earlier: `pap.yml`
(version controlled), `pap.local.yml` (gitignored, local stage and
`default-stage` belong here).

Minimal `pap.yml`:

```yaml
settings:
  sync-paths:
    - source: public/
      target: public/
    - source: vendor/
      target: vendor/
  composer:
    working-directory: ./

stages:
  live:
    user: deployer
    host: example.com
    origin: https://www.example.com/
    working-directory: /var/www/myapp/
    rsync:
      options: -razc
```

Minimal `pap.local.yml`:

```yaml
settings:
  default-stage: local
stages:
  local:
    origin: http://localhost:8000
```

Settings:

- `settings.default-stage` - stage used when none is given (default: `local`)
- `settings.sync-paths` - list of `{source, target}` paths to rsync
- `settings.prepare-sync-paths` - list of `{source, target}` paths to rearrange inside the repository before sync
- `settings.composer.working-directory` - directory of `composer.json`
- `settings.composer.phar` - path to Composer, if not installed globally
- `settings.assets` - asset pipeline: `mirror`, `concat`, `minify-css`, `minify-js`, `minify-img`
- `settings.lint.lint-paths` - directories to lint
- `settings.unit-test.phpunit.working-directory`, `settings.unit-test.phpunit.config` - PHPUnit setup
- `settings.test.codeception.working-directory`, `settings.test.codeception.suite` - Codeception setup
- `settings.watch.working-directory` - directory to watch

The sections `assets`, `lint`, `lint.fix`, `unit-test` and `test` accept a
`scripts:` list instead, which replaces the built-in implementation with
custom shell commands.

Stages (`stages.<name>`):

- `user` - SSH user
- `host` - SSH host; omit to skip file sync (app served from the Git checkout)
- `port` - SSH port (default: 22)
- `origin` - public URL, used by smoke tests, integration tests and `view`
- `working-directory` - absolute path on the host, with trailing slash
- `rsync.options` - rsync flags (no default, `init` writes `-razc`)
- `composer.phar` - path to Composer on the host
- `lock-branches` - list of Git branches allowed to deploy to this stage
- `test.deny-groups` - Codeception groups to exclude for this stage

## Optional

- [Upgrade guide](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap/blob/master/docs/upgrade-guide.md): Breaking changes between major versions
- [pap-skeleton](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap-skeleton): Project template for `composer create-project`
- [pap-dist](https://github.com/pixelbrackets/pap-dist/releases): Pre-built PHAR and Linux binaries
